fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry id/slug/headline-style fields, sourced primarily from the WordPress REST API (S1-wpapi) or, on API failure, ld+json + HTML (S2-jsonld+html). Latest-mode records (S3-rss, the site's RSS feed) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-wpapi (WordPress REST API, primary), S2-jsonld+html (fallback, used only if the REST API call fails), S3-rss (latest mode).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_500, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: Post ID
id.description: Internal numeric WordPress post ID. S1-wpapi only.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug of the post. S1-wpapi only.

link.title: Link
link.description: Canonical article URL, as reported by the WordPress REST API.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary -- from the WordPress excerpt (S1) or ld+json description (S2).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, paragraphs joined with a blank line. Can be null/empty for 'Video'-category posts, whose real content is a video embed rather than text (genuine site shape, not a parse failure -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md).

date.title: Date
date.description: Publish date/time in the site's local timezone (Africa/Lusaka, UTC+2), as returned verbatim by WordPress -- no 'Z'/offset suffix. S1-wpapi only; use datePublished-equivalent 'date' from S2 for the fallback path.

date_gmt.title: Date (UTC)
date_gmt.description: Publish date/time in UTC, as returned verbatim by the WordPress REST API (field name kept as upstream: date_gmt). S1-wpapi only.

modified.title: Modified
modified.description: Last-modified date/time in local timezone, verbatim from WordPress. S1-wpapi only (S2 reuses this field name for ld+json's dateModified).

modified_gmt.title: Modified (UTC)
modified_gmt.description: Last-modified date/time in UTC, verbatim from WordPress. S1-wpapi only.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name. Real individual/staff name on S1-wpapi and S3-rss (via the WP REST embedded author / RSS dc:creator); always the generic "TIMES OF ZAMBIA" organization on the S2 ld+json fallback, since ld+json does not expose the real per-article author on this site.

authorSlug.title: Author slug
authorSlug.description: WordPress author archive slug. S1-wpapi only.

authorLink.title: Author link
authorLink.description: URL of the author's archive page on the site. S1-wpapi only.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of category names attached to the post (e.g. ["Sport"], ["Business"]). S1-wpapi only.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: List of tag names attached to the post. S1-wpapi only.

featuredImage.title: Featured image
featuredImage.description: Lead image object (url/width/height/altText on S1-wpapi; url only on the S2 fallback).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: WordPress-internal GUID URL (e.g. https://times.co.zm/?p=236). S1-wpapi only; latest-mode records use the RSS feed's own 'guid' field of the same name.

contentProtected.title: Content protected
contentProtected.description: WordPress's own paywall/protected-content flag on the post body -- observed false on every sampled article (no paywall found on this site). S1-wpapi only.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode (S3-rss) headline item.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish date/time string, verbatim from the RSS feed. Latest mode only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
